newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 17.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Revised organ transplant bill to be enacted today.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) tax panel eyes abolition of securities transaction tax by the year ending March 31, 2000.
-- Marubeni Corp to set up 'in-house bank,' prompted by the liberalisation of foreign exchange dealing next April.
-- Use of birth control pills will most likely be approved this autumn.
-- Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd plans to tie up with Britain's Barclays Bank.
-- Poll shows that 68 percent of people in Mitake in Gifu Prefecture oppose waste disposal plant construction.
